chibi-martian-monument-conqueror.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:MARTIAN:CONQUEROR
chibi-martian-monument-conqueror.notes: Candidate 0 of 16: a small triumphal arch of silver-white chrome on round pylons with an open gateway, a big chrome laurel wreath with hot magenta lights on its top and two crossed chrome ray guns on its lintel; the Conqueror's arch and wreath in Martian chrome, lit from the left. 3, 8, 9, 12 and 14 are close without magenta; 2, 6, 10 and 11 a magenta orb in place of the wreath; 4 a ring.

chibi-martian-monument-engineer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:MARTIAN:ENGINEER
chibi-martian-monument-engineer.notes: Candidate 0 of 16: a square gunmetal pillar topped by a big chrome cogwheel standing on its edge with a hot magenta hub, a crossed chrome spanner and ray tool on its front; the Engineer's cog and crossed tools in Martian metal, lit from the left. 9 and 10 are close with huge crossed spanners; 1, 5 and 7 stacks of rings; 4, 11 and 14 a cog lying flat; 6 an arch; 8 and 12 a lattice tower.

chibi-martian-monument-explorer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:MARTIAN:EXPLORER
chibi-martian-monument-explorer.notes: Candidate 10 of 16: a silver-white chrome needle obelisk with a glass ball on its tip, a hot magenta compass rose on its front and a chrome telescope on a gunmetal tripod at its foot; the Explorer's compass and spyglass in Martian chrome, lit from the left. The sixteen are near twins; 0, 5 and 8 have green pixels in the rose, 11 has no rose, 12 and 15 turn it sideways.

chibi-martian-monument-land-baron.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:MARTIAN:LAND_BARON
chibi-martian-monument-land-baron.notes: Candidate 10 of 16: a stout gunmetal boundary block with chrome edges, a chrome shield bearing a small flying saucer on its front, a chrome crown with a hot magenta gem on its top and a small chrome signpost with two arrow plates; the Land Baron's crowned boundary stone and signpost in Martian metal, lit from the left. The sixteen are near twins; 1, 5 and 6 hide the signpost behind the block.

chibi-martian-monument-muster.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:MARTIAN:MUSTER
chibi-martian-monument-muster.notes: Candidate 8 of 16 (resumed after a dropped poll): a tall chrome pylon hung with four shields (a round chrome disc and three chrome and gunmetal kite shields) under two chrome horn loudspeakers on its top; the Muster's shields under a horn in Martian chrome. A weak row: most candidates are tall columns that touch the top edge with small plates; 9 and 11 are close; no candidate shows the magenta light on a shield clearly.
